summary.text: The story takes place on Innistrad, where Avacyn has been trapped in the Helvault by the demon Griselbrand, leaving the plane without a protector as the Church conceals her fate and creatures of the night close in.
Gisa and Geralf besiege Thraben, where Mikaeus is killed and then raised by Liliana Vess, who forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault by threatening her soldiers.
That Sundering frees Avacyn, who casts the Cursemute and creates the Wolfir, while Sorin Markov, who once created her, returns to find vampires killing at will.
